+"""Test harness for sort_list."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sorting import sort_list
+
+
+class TestSortList(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_empty_list(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sort_list([]), [])
+
+    def test_single_element(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sort_list([42]), [42])
+
+    def test_duplicates(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sort_list([5, 2, 9, 2, 5, 1]), [1, 2, 2, 5, 5, 9])
+
+    def test_already_sorted(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sort_list([1, 2, 3]), [1, 2, 3])
+
+    def test_reverse_sorted(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sort_list([3, 2, 1]), [1, 2, 3])
+
+    def test_negatives(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sort_list([0, -3, 7, -1]), [-3, -1, 0, 7])
+
+    def test_input_not_mutated(self):
+        original = [3, 1, 2]
+        sort_list(original)
+        self.assertEqual(original, [3, 1, 2])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
